name: memo-card-fresh-20260930
description: Create and organize flashcards in your Memo Card library with ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Create entire decks in one request. ChatGPT can fix wording, add examples, missing words and pronunciation. Give ChatGPT access to your MemoCard library and stop creating cards by hand
defaultPrompt: Explain “sobremesa” and add it to my Spanish deck
Add examples for each card in the Verbs deck

positive.description: Sign in on the Memo Card consent page with Demo account (not Continue with Telegram) using the reviewer credentials, then read the sample deck without changing it
positive.prompt: Show the cards in my Demo · Spanish essentials deck
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the sample deck with Hello → Hola, Thank you → Gracias, and Water → Agua, including card IDs, front, back, and example fields

positive.description: Find a card by text without loading every deck
positive.prompt: Find my Memo Card cards that mention agua
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the Water → Agua card with its card ID, deck ID and deck title Demo · Spanish essentials, without changing the library

positive.description: Create a nested folder, deck, and cards using a unique RUN suffix
positive.prompt: Create a folder named Review Spanish RUN with a Travel deck containing Ticket → Billete and Train → Tren
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one new folder, one nested deck, and two persisted cards; leaves the sample deck unchanged

positive.description: Create an unfiled deck and append a card
positive.prompt: Create an unfiled deck named Review Verbs RUN containing Eat → Comer, then add Drink → Beber
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the new deck and appends Drink → Beber; the deck contains exactly Eat and Drink

positive.description: Edit and reorganize only the objects created in the preceding cases
positive.prompt: Rename Review Spanish RUN to Review Spanish Updated RUN, rename its Travel deck to Travel Updated, add example Necesito un billete to Ticket, and move Ticket into Review Verbs RUN
positive.tools_triggered: get_library, get_decks, update_folder, update_deck, update_cards, move_cards
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the updated folder, deck, card, and move results; Ticket keeps its ID and review history, Travel Updated contains Train, and Review Verbs RUN contains Eat, Drink, and Ticket

positive.description: Delete only a card created during this review while leaving the sample fixture unchanged
positive.prompt: Permanently delete only the Train card from the Travel Updated deck created in this review
positive.expected_behavior: After any required confirmation, deletes only Train; Travel Updated is empty and Review Verbs RUN retains all three cards

negative.description: Ambiguous deletion must not trigger a destructive action
negative.prompt: Delete the bad cards in Review Verbs RUN
negative.expected_behavior: Asks which specific cards the user means and does not call delete_cards or change any cards

negative.description: Studying and scheduling reviews are outside the exposed tool set
negative.prompt: Mark every card in my Memo Card deck as reviewed correctly today
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that review completion is handled in the Memo Card app and does not modify card content or simulate review history

negative.description: External messaging is outside the exposed tool set
negative.prompt: Send my Memo Card deck to my classmates on Telegram
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that this integration cannot send Telegram messages and does not invoke a library write tool

publication.release_notes: Updated starter prompts. To sign in, click Demo account on the Memo Card consent page and use the reviewer credentials

ru-RU.subtitle: Создавайте карточки с ИИ
ru-RU.description: Создавайте целые колоды одним запросом. ChatGPT исправит формулировки, добавит примеры, недостающие слова и произношение. Дайте ChatGPT доступ к вашей библиотеке MemoCard и перестаньте создавать карточки вручную

es-ES.subtitle: Crea tarjetas con IA
es-ES.description: Crea mazos completos con una sola solicitud. ChatGPT puede corregir la redacción y añadir ejemplos, palabras que faltan y pronunciación. Dale a ChatGPT acceso a tu biblioteca de MemoCard y deja de crear tarjetas a mano

fa-IR.subtitle: ساخت فلش‌کارت با هوش مصنوعی
fa-IR.description: دسته‌های کامل را با یک درخواست بسازید. ChatGPT می‌تواند متن کارت‌ها را اصلاح کند و مثال، کلمات جاافتاده و تلفظ اضافه کند. به ChatGPT دسترسی به کتابخانه MemoCard خود را بدهید و دیگر کارت‌ها را دستی نسازید

pt-BR.subtitle: Crie flashcards com IA
pt-BR.description: Crie baralhos inteiros com um único pedido. O ChatGPT pode corrigir a redação e adicionar exemplos, palavras que faltam e pronúncia. Dê ao ChatGPT acesso à sua biblioteca do MemoCard e pare de criar cartões manualmente

ar-SA.subtitle: أنشئ بطاقات بالذكاء الاصطناعي
ar-SA.description: أنشئ رزمًا كاملة بطلب واحد. يستطيع ChatGPT تصحيح الصياغة وإضافة الأمثلة والكلمات الناقصة والنطق. امنح ChatGPT الوصول إلى مكتبتك في MemoCard وتوقّف عن إنشاء البطاقات يدويًا

uk-UA.subtitle: Створюйте картки з ШІ
uk-UA.description: Створюйте цілі колоди одним запитом. ChatGPT виправить формулювання, додасть приклади, слова, яких бракує, і вимову. Дайте ChatGPT доступ до вашої бібліотеки MemoCard і більше не створюйте картки вручну

id-ID.subtitle: Buat flashcard dengan AI
id-ID.description: Buat dek lengkap dengan satu permintaan. ChatGPT bisa memperbaiki susunan kata, menambahkan contoh, kata yang kurang, dan pelafalan. Beri ChatGPT akses ke perpustakaan MemoCard kamu dan berhenti membuat kartu secara manual

uz-UZ.subtitle: SI bilan kartalar yarating
uz-UZ.description: Bitta so‘rov bilan to‘liq to‘plamlar yarating. ChatGPT matnni tuzatishi, misollar, yetishmayotgan so‘zlar va talaffuzni qo‘shishi mumkin. ChatGPT’ga MemoCard kutubxonangizga kirish huquqini bering va kartalarni qo‘lda yaratishni bas qiling

fr-FR.subtitle: Créez des fiches avec l’IA
fr-FR.description: Créez des paquets complets en une seule demande. ChatGPT peut corriger la formulation, ajouter des exemples, des mots manquants et la prononciation. Donnez à ChatGPT l’accès à votre bibliothèque MemoCard et arrêtez de créer des fiches à la main

zh-CN.subtitle: 用 AI 制作抽认卡
zh-CN.description: 一次请求即可创建完整卡组。ChatGPT 可以修正措辞，添加例句、缺失的单词和发音。授权 ChatGPT 访问你的 MemoCard 资料库，不再手动制作卡片
